description.name: requirements.check

description.name: result.preview

description.name: execution.preflight

description.name: credits.options
description.description: FREE read-only legacy credit compatibility status. New prepaid-credit sales are disabled in v4; historical paid credits remain redeemable through a separate compatibility path.

description.name: x402.compatibility_audit
description.description: PAID $1.00 USDC on Base via x402. Audits an x402 endpoint for v1/v2 compatibility defects. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

description.name: mcp.schema_audit
description.description: PAID $1.00 USDC on Base via x402. Scores supplied MCP tool schemas for discoverability, descriptions, and bounded input contracts. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

description.name: openapi.quality_audit
description.description: PAID $1.00 USDC on Base via x402. Evaluates structural quality and required fields in an OpenAPI document. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

description.name: machine_commerce.readiness_audit
description.description: PAID $2.00 USDC on Base via x402. Checks machine-commerce discovery and health surfaces. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

description.name: artifact.integrity_manifest
description.description: PAID $0.10 USDC on Base via x402. Creates deterministic SHA-256 entries and a root manifest hash for supplied text artifacts. Calling this MCP tool does not spend funds; it returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and canonical paid execution endpoint.

description.name: hash.encode
description.description: PAID $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Computes a SHA-256 digest and UTF-8 byte count for supplied text. Calling this MCP tool returns a payment challenge and does not autonomously spend funds.

description.name: secret.scan
description.description: PAID $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Detects selected credential patterns and returns classifications and positions, not matched values. Heuristic, not comprehensive. Calling this MCP tool returns a payment challenge and does not autonomously spend funds.

description.name: pii.scan
description.description: PAID $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Detects selected personal-data patterns and returns classifications and positions, not matched values. Heuristic, not comprehensive. Calling this MCP tool returns a payment challenge and does not autonomously spend funds.

description.name: json.repair
description.description: PAID $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Validates JSON and repairs a limited set of formatting errors. May return supplied content. Calling this MCP tool returns a payment challenge and does not autonomously spend funds.

description.name: prompt.audit
description.description: PAID $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Scores selected prompt structure signals using deterministic heuristics. Calling this MCP tool returns a payment challenge and does not autonomously spend funds.

description.name: mcp.launch_audit
description.description: PAID $9.00 USDC on Base via x402. Performs bounded live MCP discovery, health, transport, schema, and receiver-only checks against a public endpoint. No payment is attempted by the audit.

description.name: x402.purchase_path_audit
description.description: PAID $19.00 USDC on Base via x402. Performs a bounded no-payment purchase-challenge audit for a selected capability, validating status, requirements, destination, amount, and receiver-only controls.

description.name: xkey.validate
description.description: PAID $0.10 USDC on Base via x402. Validates and normalizes one bounded XKEY intake payload. Calling this MCP tool returns the exact PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and does not spend funds.
